steps.title: Identify the payer
howto: Ask who will pay for care: the family, Medicaid, the VA, a long-term care policy, or something else.
CDS (self-directed) is a different program: send those families to caringcds.com instead of starting here.
Pick the payer. For Other, write the payer or source; an owner reviews it next.

steps.title: Confirm the client's basics
howto: Open Lead intake on this profile.
Fill in the client's name, date of birth, home address and phone.
The Hub ticks this step by itself once all four are on the profile.

steps.title: Owner reviews the Other payer
howto: Read who the payer is and what the family said.
Decide whether we can accept it and how billing will work.
Write how billing will work (or why not). It stays on the record.

options.l: Go ahead: we can work with this payer

steps.title: Check eMOMED eligibility
howto: Sign in to eMOMED.
Look up the client by DCN (or name and date of birth).
Check the eligibility for the current month.
Take a screenshot of the eligibility screen.
Attach it here, enter the date and the result.

rule.message: Not eligible in eMOMED. The journey stops here unless an owner allows an exception.

steps.title: Review FUSION: care plan, authorization, notes and history
howto: Open the client in FUSION.
Read the care plan.
Read the authorization and services.
Read the notes and history all the way back, including provider changes and any 21-day notices.
Save or screenshot what you reviewed and attach it here.
Tick each part you reviewed. Write anything concerning.

fields.label: I reviewed the authorization and services
I reviewed the FUSION notes and history, not only the care plan

steps.title: Count the prior 21-day notices
howto: Use the FUSION notes and history you just reviewed.
Count every prior 21-day notice (a provider ending services with notice).
0 or 1 continues. 2 or more stops: only an owner can allow an exception, with a written reason.

rule.message: 2 or more prior 21-day notices: do not accept. Only an owner (Samantha or Zachary) can allow an exception.

fields.label: How many prior 21-day notices are documented?

steps.title: Upload and review the Medicaid care plan
howto: Download the care plan from FUSION.
Attach it here.
Read it for: authorized services and hours, days and times, ADLs, transfers (Hoyer, sit-to-stand, gait belt), mobility and fall risk, dementia, behaviors or safety, and location.
Enter the authorized hours per week and whether we can staff it.

fields.label: I reviewed services, hours, ADLs, transfers and equipment, mobility, fall risk, dementia, behaviors and location

steps.title: Decide whether to assess
howto: Scheduling the assessment does not mean we accept the client.
If the review raised no reason to stop, choose Move forward and call to book the in-person assessment.
If we shouldn't take the case, choose Decline and say why.

options.l: Move forward: schedule the in-person assessment

steps.title: Receive the VA referral and authorization
howto: Get the referral and authorization from VA Community Care (HSRM).
Attach it here and enter the referral number and authorized hours.

steps.title: Review the policy and confirm benefits with the carrier
howto: Read the policy (the Hub's LTC policy reader can help).
Call the carrier to confirm benefits, the elimination period and claim steps.
Attach the policy or the carrier's confirmation and enter what they said.

steps.title: Book the in-home assessment
howto: Call the family and agree a time for the in-person assessment.
Book it from this profile (Book the visit).
The Hub ticks this step by itself once the visit is booked.

steps.title: Record the assessment outcome
howto: After the visit, record what happened.
Wants to think about it / Follow-up needed: choose it and set a check-back date, so they come back to you.
Needs management review: an owner decides next.

rule.message: Not moving forward after the assessment.

steps.title: Family chose Caring Companions
howto: When the family says yes, press They said yes on the Leads board or here.
It records who marked it and when, moves the family off the Leads board into Getting ready, and lands you on the next step.
Pressed by mistake? Undo within 24 hours (an owner can undo later). Nothing is re-typed: this is the same profile.

steps.title: Service agreement signed and on file
howto: Have the client or responsible party sign the service agreement.
Scan or photograph it and attach it here.

steps.title: Client rights signed and on file
howto: Attach the signed client rights.

steps.title: Assessment on file
howto: Attach the completed assessment.

steps.title: Create the client in AxisCare
howto: Check the profile's name, DOB, address and phone are right.
Use Convert to AxisCare on this profile (or Use this AxisCare record if AxisCare already has them).
The Hub ticks this step by itself once it can read the client back from AxisCare.

steps.title: Responsible parties and emergency contacts in AxisCare
howto: Open the client in AxisCare.
Go to the client's Responsible Parties.
Add each responsible party and emergency contact with phone, relationship and whether they can make medical decisions.
Save, then confirm here.

steps.title: Care tasks in AxisCare
howto: Send the care plan tasks from the Care tab, or add them in AxisCare under the client's ADLs.
Confirm here.

steps.title: Allergies, medications and attributes in AxisCare
howto: Open the client in AxisCare.
Enter allergies, medications and diagnoses.
Set attributes (pets, smoking, dementia, gender preference, language).
Add the mailing address if it differs.
Confirm here.

steps.title: Signed documents uploaded to AxisCare
howto: Open the client in AxisCare, Documents.
Upload the service agreement, client rights, assessment (and the Medicaid care plan).
Confirm here.

steps.title: Private pay setup: rate, billing contact, payment method
howto: Agree the rate and service level (it's in the service agreement).
Set the billing contact and payment method (and autopay if they chose it).
Set up billing for the client in AxisCare.
Confirm here.

steps.title: Record the authorization
howto: Take the service, hours and dates from the authorization.
Enter them in AxisCare on the client's authorization.
Record them here: the schedule is checked against these hours.

steps.title: LTC billing and claims setup
howto: Set up who files claims and how often.
Set the private-pay portion (elimination period) if any.
Confirm here.

steps.title: Billing set up the way the owner decided
howto: Follow the owner's note on the Other payer step.
Confirm here.

steps.title: Payer set up in AxisCare
howto: Open the client in AxisCare, Billing.
Add the payer and the service the client is authorized for.
Confirm here.

steps.title: Confirm the requested schedule
howto: Write what the client needs, not who we have: every day and time.
Enter the hours per week and the start date.
For Medicaid and VA, the hours must fit the authorization.

rule.message: The requested hours are above the authorized hours. Fix the schedule or get an owner's exception.

steps.title: Enter the full schedule in AxisCare, open shifts included
howto: Open the client in AxisCare, Schedule.
Create every shift the client needs.
Shifts with nobody yet: leave the caregiver empty so they show as open.
Confirm here.

steps.title: Staff every shift
howto: Open the Team tab.
For each open shift, find and confirm a caregiver (Text several helps).
Confirm here once no shift in the first two weeks is open.

steps.title: Brief the caregivers on the client
howto: Call each caregiver on the team: care needs, home, family, what matters to the client.
Confirm here.

steps.title: Tell the family the start plan
howto: Call the family: start date, who is coming, what to expect.
Record the exact words on the Start Contract.
Confirm here.

steps.title: Notify the state as required
howto: Notify DSDS of the start as the program requires.
Confirm here.

steps.title: First visit happened
howto: The Hub ticks this once AxisCare shows the first clock-in.
If it can't see it, confirm by hand with a reason.

steps.title: Review the first shift note
howto: Read the first visit's care note (the profile shows it under From the shifts).
Confirm here.

steps.title: Call the family after the first visit
howto: Call the family: how did it go? Anything to change?
Confirm here with what they said.

steps.title: Get the caregiver's feedback
howto: Call the caregiver: how did it go?
Confirm here.

steps.title: Address care plan changes
howto: Make any changes the first week showed (tasks, times, notes).
Confirm here (or note that none were needed).

steps.title: Address any remaining open shifts
howto: Check the Team tab for open shifts in the next two weeks.
Fill them or set a plan.
Confirm here.

steps.title: Complete start of care
howto: Everything above is done.
Complete start of care: the client becomes Active. The journey stays on the profile as the record of how they started.
